Recipes.RecipeContent:
RECIPE: CVD-001  氧化矽薄膜沉積
PROCESS: Low Pressure CVD (LPCVD)
ENGINEER: 張志明
EQUIPMENT: CVD-TOOL-A
LAST_EDIT: 2026-04-24

# Step 1: Preheat
Temperature   = 350 °C    [200~400]   ★KEY
Pressure      = 5.2 Torr  [3.0~8.0]   ★KEY
Duration      = 120 sec   [60~300]
Ramp_Rate     = 5 °C/min  [2~10]

# Step 2: Deposition
Temperature   = 420 °C    [380~450]   ★KEY
Pressure      = 3.8 Torr  [2.0~6.0]   ★KEY
RF_Power      = 1500 W    [800~2000]  ★KEY
GasFlow_SiH4  = 85 sccm   [40~120]    ★KEY  <- 草稿調整中
GasFlow_N2    = 200 sccm  [100~400]
Duration      = 300 sec   [120~600]
Target_Thickness = 150 nm [100~200]

# Step 3: Purge
GasFlow_N2    = 500 sccm  [300~800]
Duration      = 60 sec    [30~120]

# QC Criteria
Thickness_Uniformity <= 3.0%
Refractive_Index     = 1.46 ± 0.02

# Memo
本配方適用 300mm 晶圓。
GasFlow_SiH4 = 85 尚未提交版本（草稿狀態）。
N2 purge 流量依批次晶圓批號調整。

RECIPE: CVD-002  氮化矽保護層
PROCESS: Plasma Enhanced CVD (PECVD)
ENGINEER: 張志明
EQUIPMENT: CVD-TOOL-B

# Step 1: Chamber Clean
Duration      = 30 sec

# Step 2: Deposition
Temperature   = 380 °C    [350~420]   ★KEY
Pressure      = 4.5 Torr  [3.0~7.0]   ★KEY
RF_Power      = 1200 W    [600~1600]  ★KEY
GasFlow_SiH4  = 60 sccm   [30~100]    ★KEY
GasFlow_NH3   = 150 sccm  [80~250]    ★KEY
Duration      = 240 sec   [120~480]

# Step 3: Purge
GasFlow_N2    = 400 sccm
Duration      = 45 sec

# Memo
全面重構後版本，提升緻密性至目標值 > 2.8 g/cm³。

RECIPE: ETCH-001  多晶矽閘極蝕刻
PROCESS: Reactive Ion Etching (RIE)
ENGINEER: 陳工程師
EQUIPMENT: ETCH-TOOL-A

# Step 1: Breakthrough
Bias_Power    = 100 W     [50~200]
Pressure      = 10 mTorr  [5~20]
CF4_Flow      = 50 sccm   [20~80]
Duration      = 15 sec

# Step 2: Main Etch
Bias_Power    = 250 W     [150~400]   ★KEY
Pressure      = 8 mTorr   [5~15]      ★KEY
Cl2_Flow      = 80 sccm   [40~120]    ★KEY
HBr_Flow      = 40 sccm   [20~60]     ★KEY
Selectivity   > 15:1
Duration      = 90 sec    [60~150]

# Step 3: Over-Etch
Bias_Power    = 150 W
Duration      = 20 sec    [10~40]

# Memo
選擇比優化版本，CD uniformity < 2nm (3σ)。

RECIPE: CVD-003  高介電閘極氧化層
PROCESS: Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD)
ENGINEER: 張志明
EQUIPMENT: ALD-TOOL-A
STATUS: 草稿

# Step 1: Surface Prep
Temperature   = 250 °C
Duration      = 60 sec

# Step 2: HfO2 ALD Cycle (x40)
Precursor     = HfCl4
Oxidant       = H2O
Pulse_A       = 0.1 sec
Purge_A       = 5.0 sec
Pulse_B       = 0.1 sec
Purge_B       = 5.0 sec
Target_EOT    = 1.0 nm   (實驗階段)

# Memo
初始實驗版本，參數尚在調整中。EOT 目標值 < 1.5 nm。

RECIPE: PVD-001  鈦金屬接觸層
PROCESS: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering
ENGINEER: 林工程師
EQUIPMENT: PVD-TOOL-A

# Step 1: Pre-sputter Clean
Ar_Flow       = 30 sccm
Power         = 200 W
Duration      = 30 sec

# Step 2: Ti Deposition
Power         = 3000 W   [2000~4000]  ★KEY
Ar_Flow       = 40 sccm  [20~60]      ★KEY
Pressure      = 2 mTorr  [1~5]        ★KEY
Target_Thick  = 100 Å    [80~120]
Duration      = 45 sec

# Step 3: TiN Barrier
N2_Flow       = 20 sccm  [10~30]
Ar_Flow       = 20 sccm
Power         = 2500 W
Target_Thick  = 50 Å

# Memo
Ti/TiN 阻障層，接觸電阻 < 50 Ω·µm²。

RECIPE: ETCH-002  接觸孔蝕刻
PROCESS: RIE
ENGINEER: 陳工程師
STATUS: 已廢止

# Memo
此配方已廢止，請改用 ETCH-003。
